title: CreatableSelect
summary: The open field keeps its teal focused look even while the pointer is over the list or focus leaves the input. Rows are 4px-radius (were 6px), the arrow-key highlight gets a teal ring (mouse hover does not), the selected check pops in, and the panel fades and slides in.
why: Task brief research summary (HeroUI, Mantine, shadcn/ui, Untitled UI, React Aria, Fluent): 'modern' here comes from connectedness and polish, not flashy motion. (Not re-researched in this pass.)

Connectedness: the trigger should read as part of its open panel. Measured before: while the list was open the Select trigger border was #E9EAEB with no glow, because Radix moves focus into the list and the focused look is keyed to `focus:`.
Concentric radii (inner radius = outer radius - padding): the panel is 8px with 4px padding, so rows should be 4px. Measured before: Select and Creatable rows 6px, Dropdown and SearchFilter rows 0px.
Selection feedback should be acknowledged briefly: the same fade + 85% to 100% scale as the v2 Checkbox tick, 180ms.

scenarioLabels.03-hover-row: Open, mouse hover on a row
scenarioLabels.04b-keyboard-then-hover: Keyboard highlight, then mouse takes over
scenarioLabels.06-create-row: Typed a new value: Create row highlighted

motion.before: spins in to 180deg on open (200ms, spring)
motion.after: unchanged (it is a new element each time the field opens, so closing snaps back)
180ms opacity 0 to 100% + scale 85% to 100%, spring ease (--v2-ease-spring; sampled critically damped curve, fallback cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))

motion.before: no visible motion (fade/zoom/slide cancelled by a utility-order bug)
motion.after: 200ms: opacity 0 to 100%, scale 98% to 100%, 4px slide down, origin top left, spring ease (--v2-ease-spring; sampled critically damped curve, fallback cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))

states: Field / open: focused look held (also under hover)
Option row / arrow-key highlighted: fill #F5F5F5 + inside stroke 1px #27ABB8
Option row / mouse hover: fill only
Create row / arrow-key highlighted: same ring
Option row / selected: check enters with scale/fade
figmaSteps: Field State=Open: fill #FFFFFF, border 1px #27ABB8 (--color-secondary-600) + drop shadow x0 y0 blur 4 spread 0 #27ABB8 @ 40%, radius 8, height 40, padding 8 / 16. Same as Focus. Open + hover keeps #27ABB8. Error + Open: #F04438 + 0 0 4 0 #F04438 @ 40%. Disabled unchanged.

Panel: unchanged (radius 8, border 1px #E9EAEB, shadow 0 4 8 -2 rgba(16,24,40,0.10) + 0 2 4 -2 rgba(16,24,40,0.06), 4px gap below the field, list padding 4, max-height 240px; hint row above with 1px bottom border).

Option row: corner radius 4 (was 6), padding 8 top/bottom, 16 left, 32 right, 16/400 #5E5E5E, hover and highlight fill #F5F5F5. Add variant Keyboard highlight: fill #F5F5F5 + inside stroke 1px #27ABB8 (radius 4). Mouse hover stays fill-only.
Create row: radius 4, 16/400 link colour, same highlight fill; keyboard highlight adds the same stroke.
Selected row: label 16/500 #484848, check icon 16px #2BBCCA 8px from the right; prototype entrance 180ms, opacity 0 to 100% + scale 85% to 100%.
Panel prototype: 200ms Smart animate from opacity 0%, scale 98%, y -4 to the resting state, origin top-left.
notes: Origin-aware panel: NOT applicable. This panel is CSS-anchored (absolute, top-full, no floating-ui) and cannot flip, so it always opens bottom-start and the fixed top-left origin is already correct. A flip would need a floating-ui conversion (strategy absolute + flip), which changes positioning; proposed, not done.

The arrow-key ring is driven by component state (who last moved the highlight), not focus-visible, because focus stays in the input. Verified in browser: hover shows fill only; ArrowDown shows fill + ring; the mouse taking over removes the ring.
Closing does not rotate the chevron back: the closed and open fields are different elements, so there is nothing to transition. Making them one element is a larger refactor.
The input has no aria-activedescendant for the highlighted row (pre-existing accessibility gap).

Observation, not changed: the selected check uses four different colours today: Select/CreatableSelect #2BBCCA (semantic-brand), Dropdown/SearchFilter #27ABB8 (semantic-border-accent), MultiSelect #343E55 (semantic-primary). Worth unifying in Figma.

Found while verifying motion: `motion-safe:animate-in` is emitted after bare `fade-in-0`/`zoom-in-*` classes and resets --tw-enter-opacity/--tw-enter-scale to initial, so the panel fade and 98% zoom documented in V2-MOTION.md never ran in normal-motion mode (measured at t=0: opacity 1, no scale). Fixed here by prefixing those classes with `motion-safe:` (as Checkbox/TextField already do). The same bare pattern remains in dialog.tsx, toast.tsx, tabs.tsx, date-range-picker.tsx and date-time-picker.tsx (not in this task's files, not individually verified).
